name: Agumon
look: a little yellow-orange dinosaur standing upright: a big head with a rounded snout full of small teeth, bright green eyes, stubby arms and feet with big white claws, and a thick tail
entry: A brave little dinosaur Digimon with sharp claws. It spits its Pepper Breath at anything that threatens its friends, and it is always, always hungry.
how: Wild: uncommon in plains, forests and savannas.
Evolves into Greymon at level 20, learning Mega Flame.
Evolves into Agumon -Yuki no Kizuna- at level 50.
